description: Strict testcase-node JUnit outcome parsing and report-specific suite identity.

cases.description: A failure node cannot be hidden by a suite declaring zero failures.
cases.xml: <testsuite name="same" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="fails"><failure message="bad"/></testcase></testsuite>

cases.description: An error node cannot be hidden by a suite declaring zero errors.
cases.xml: <testsuite name="same" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="errors"><error message="bad"/></testcase></testsuite>

cases.description: A skipped node cannot be hidden by a suite declaring zero skips.
Declared test totals must equal actual testcase nodes.
cases.xml: <testsuite name="parameterized" tests="3" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="case[0]"/><testcase name="case[1]"/></testsuite>

cases.description: Parent testsuites totals must reconcile with child testcase outcomes.
cases.xml: <testsuites tests="2" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testsuite name="suite" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="one"/></testsuite></testsuites>

cases.description: Equal suite names from distinct task/device report paths retain separate identities.
cases.xml: <testsuite name="same" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="case[0]"/></testsuite>
cases.related_xml: <testsuite name="same" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="case[1]"/></testsuite>

cases.description: Valid parameterized testcase nodes are counted individually.
cases.xml: <testsuite name="parameterized" tests="2" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="case[0]"/><testcase name="case[1]"/></testsuite>

cases.description: A nested suite cannot hide a failed testcase from direct-child totals.
cases.xml: <testsuite name="outer" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="visible-pass"/><testsuite name="inner" tests="1" failures="1" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="hidden-failure"><failure/></testcase></testsuite></testsuite>

cases.description: A nested suite cannot hide an errored testcase from direct-child totals.
cases.xml: <testsuites tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testsuite name="outer" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="visible-pass"/><testsuite name="inner" tests="1" failures="0" errors="1" skipped="0"><testcase name="hidden-error"><error/></testcase></testsuite></testsuite></testsuites>

cases.description: A nested suite cannot hide a skipped testcase from direct-child totals.
cases.xml: <testsuites tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testsuite name="outer" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="0"><testcase name="visible-pass"/><testsuite name="inner" tests="1" failures="0" errors="0" skipped="1"><testcase name="hidden-skip"><skipped/></testcase></testsuite></testsuite></testsuites>

cases.description: A testcase hidden below an unsupported wrapper cannot be omitted.
cases.expected_error: testcase elements outside its direct children
